title: drain_once: while-let silently swallows read_dir errors mid-scan
description: Original 5ff96e0 used while let Ok(Some(entry)) = dir.next_entry().await — a read_dir entry error silently breaks the loop with no log, potentially leaving env_files incomplete. drain_once then delivers a partial batch with no indication anything was missed. cleanup_orphan_msg_files (changed in the round-5 fix) uses match with an explicit Err branch that logs and breaks — the two scan loops are inconsistent. The silent failure in drain_once could cause messages to be retried indefinitely or skipped.
